description: Denver climate data compiled from NOAA/NWS normals

sunshine.note: The commonly cited '300 days of sunshine' uses a more generous counting method (including any day with some sun). NOAA's strict count (mostly clear sky) is 245.

extreme_weather_days.note: Cool nights and low summer heat are advantageous for solar panel efficiency

solar_relevance.snow_duration: typically melts within 1-2 days due to sunshine
solar_relevance.panel_temp_advantage: Summer highs rarely exceed 90°F vs 110°F+ in Phoenix. Cooler panels produce more per kWh of irradiance.
